title: 타타늄 프레임 LAGET AERO ONE 킹바이크 본점 박주혁 박박사 이야기 자전거news

takeaways.text: There are no frame ports for mechanical cables or wired shifting, so only SRAM wireless groupsets work, a point both speakers note.
On the test size the fitter reads a seat angle around 73.8°, a longer top tube and a very long head tube (high stack) combined with a steep head angle of about 74°.
Seated it felt stable and easy, though not as aero as it looks; out of the saddle the high stack and steep head angle made the front very responsive and close, demanding skill.
He would recommend it to riders who mostly ride seated for comfort, but tell less skilled riders or frequent out-of-saddle riders to think twice; wheels and tires compensated for some traits.

disclosure: Filmed at King Bike, a Korean shop running test rides of the frame; the rider is an invited bike-fit specialist, and no payment is stated.
summary: A Korean shop owner and a bike-fit specialist discuss the first test ride of a LAGET AERO ONE in Korea, focusing on geometry and handling; Korean automatic captions.
